answer: Each task is instantiated after a drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse is finalized: a domain-separated hash of the pulse, task ID, and committed participant data selects its inputs and scoring nonce. Because the pulse is unpredictable beforehand, nebula-scale sybil swarms cannot precompute valid answers or farm a reusable cache offline; commit-reveal binds each response to that challenge, so a gale of fake identities gains no advantage in the haven of later rounds.
